gen-luckiest-guy-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca keeps things plain and friendly, with small capitals beside big lowercase. Luckiest Guy shouts above it in poured, one-width ink, so a heading around twice the body size would let the loud and the quiet each have room.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-liter: Liter reads modern and upright, with no stroke contrast at all and tall lowercase that stands its ground. Luckiest Guy brings the cheerful racket up top, and Liter takes over below with wide-mouthed round forms that quietly hold the text together.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-mada: Luckiest Guy has a mean, high line and ink that looks poured at a single width, loud and cheerful. Mada follows in a plain sans with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close, so a long passage feels approachable and modern.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-martel-sans: Luckiest Guy's ink looks poured at one width, with no hairlines or shadows, and that mean line sits set high and loud. Martel Sans is the sturdy partner.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-matangi: Matangi looks like twine pressed flat, with hefty lowercase. Luckiest Guy adds the cheerful shout above it, and the strongest thing here is how that loudness sits on top of such rounded, open, sturdy text.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-maven-pro: That mean, high-set line gives Luckiest Guy its loud, cheerful bite. Maven Pro in a plain sans form, with high-waisted lowercase and a welcoming gap in the c, would make a long passage feel gentle and modern.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-michroma: Michroma gives every letter a wide berth, with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips. Luckiest Guy is best at being cheerful and loud in poured, uniform strokes, while Michroma is best at spacing out contemporary sans text with daylight in every curve.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-miriam-libre: Luckiest Guy sets a mean line high and pours its ink at one width, which makes it cheerfully loud. Miriam Libre answers in sans-serif with wire-weight strokes and an s with generous openings, and that tall, cast-iron stature is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: That poured, one-width ink makes Luckiest Guy loud and cheerful. Mochiy Pop P One brings a sizable lowercase and wide gaps between letters in a plain sans, so the heading shouts while the text stays easy and spread out.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline reads professional, with oversized lowercase beside small capitals. In a plain sans like this, round bowls never swell or taper, so a longer passage moves along with breathing counters, while Luckiest Guy shouts above.
